# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.8

Version 1.4.8 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.7

- **Start on another key finishes text again** (keyboard, on PC and Android). A player who had set Start to a
  key such as Home could not finish a notice on the message board, and was stuck there.
  - **The problem:** while a text editor (message board, letters, diary...) takes keyboard input, the keys type
    instead of pressing the buttons they are set to, so that typing an "x" does not also press X. That held for
    every key, also for keys that type nothing: Start on Home pressed nothing, although the editor says "START to
    finish". With Start on Enter (the default), Enter starts a new line there, and Shift+Enter or Ctrl+Enter
    finishes, which is easy to miss.
  - **The fix:** controls set to keys the editor does not type with (Home, End, Page Up/Down, Insert, Delete, the
    F keys) still press their buttons while typing. Start on Home now finishes the text as a gamepad's Start does.
    Letters, digits, Space, Enter, Backspace, the arrows, Shift/Ctrl/Alt and mouse buttons type as before, and the
    multiplayer chat box keeps every key.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.8 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.8-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.8-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.8-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.8-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- On the message board, with Start set to Home in the controls, real key presses sent to the game window (Linux):
  - before: after typing a notice, Home did nothing and the editor stayed open;
  - after: Home finished it, the game asked "괜찮아?", and Space (A) posted it.
- With the default controls, nothing changed: "x" types (ㅌ in Korean mode) and Enter starts a new line.
- All unit tests pass.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.8, versionCode 10408).

## Known limitations

- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
